title: FICUS LYRATA potted plant
description: FICUS LYRATA potted plant, fiddle-leaf fig/stem, 12" Plants are perfect roommates – invite them into your home and create your own green oasis where you can wind down from the hustle and bustle of life. And they’re also quiet when it’s time to go to sleep!
features: This plant is sensitive to under-watering, which may cause the leaves to fall off.
Give your plants a boost with fertilizer every month. If you notice that the plant has gone dormant, leave it be until next season.
provides all potted plants with nutrient-rich soil, repotting is not needed until 1 year after purchase.
Remove dust every now and then in order to allow the plant to get as much light as possible.
The height of the plants can vary.
materialAndCare: Plant/ Substrate: Cultivated potted plant; Pot: Polypropylene
